name: Penetrate the Veil: Spoken Hearts
source:
After securing your key to power in the form of a deal with your (former) brother-in-law, things are looking up.

Though you’re determined to carry the burden of revenge on your own shoulders, Ekam is no longer willing to let you play hero and martyr. 

How will you proceed from here? 

[From [url=https://atelierursine.itch.io/penetrate-the-veil-spoken-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在与你的（前）姐夫达成协议，确保了你的权力钥匙之后，事情正在好转。

尽管你决心将复仇的重担扛在自己肩上，但埃卡姆不再愿意让你扮演英雄和烈士。

你将如何继续？

[来自[url=https://atelierursine.itch.io/penetrate-the-veil-spoken-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
